title: RunSkillSet

anyOf.description: An absolute path as the environment's operating system writes it: from /, a drive (C:\) or a share (\\).

generation.description: The generation's directory: a plugin holding a link to every member that is not native. Null when there is nothing to link.

anyOf.description: A skill set's fingerprint: it covers the members' names, folders, origins and snapshot commits and the hidden native names, so two sets with one fingerprint hold the same; a provider process spawned under another is not reused.

fingerprint.description: The set's fingerprint; null while none is resolved for the run.

name.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

repository.description: The identity of the repository the member was read from: its source's, or the trusted repository's.

path.description: The member's folder in that repository, from its root; . when the root is itself the skill.

oneOf.description: The repository the member was read from, by its identity, and the member's folder there.

repository.description: The identity of the repository the manifest says the member was copied from.

path.description: The member's folder in that repository, as the manifest names it.

anyOf.description: The commit the member was copied at, as the manifest names it: its object name, full or abbreviated.

licence.description: The licence the manifest names, an SPDX identifier where it gives one; null when it names none.

oneOf.description: What a provenance manifest beside the member names: the repository and folder it was copied from, the commit and the licence.

anyOf.description: Where a member comes from, which the readiness overlay is keyed by (repository identity and folder path): the repository it was read from, or what a provenance manifest beside a copy names.

origin.description: Where it comes from; null for a member of the own directory with no provenance manifest, or of a repository with no identity.

invocation.description: How a member is invoked: model+slash (the model may choose it, and a person may type /name), or slash-only (its frontmatter sets disable-model-invocation: true, so only /name invokes it).

native.description: Whether it lies in a root the account's adapter loads itself under trust (Claude: a trusted repository's .claude/skills and its commands), and so is not in the generation.

items.description: A member of a run's skill set as its adapter is handed it: its name, its origin, its invocation, and whether the provider loads it itself.

members.description: Every member in the set, native ones included; a shadowed, disabled or invalid member is not one.

items.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

hiddenNativeNames.description: The names of the native members switched off, which the adapter hides from its provider.

description: A run's skill set as its adapter is handed it: the generation to map, the fingerprint, every member with its name, origin, invocation and whether it is native, and the native names to hide.
